incidentSummary: Diagnosis, root-cause isolation, and resolution of startup instability, process termination, file locks, and state machine collisions.

rootCauses.symptom: NexusDesktopCompanion.exe launched in background via PowerShell run_command disappeared immediately after the tool invocation finished.
rootCauses.rootCause: In the Windows environment, non-daemon processes spawned within an ephemeral PowerShell session are bound to the Win32 Job Object of that shell. When the shell terminates at the end of the tool call, the Windows kernel enforces KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, terminating all descendant processes. When launched with proper detached flags or as a daemon background task, the process survives indefinitely.
rootCauses.remediation: Updated verification suites and launch tooling to utilize detached spawn semantics and verified 60+ second process persistence under independent Win32 process monitoring.

rootCauses.symptom: csc.exe compilation failed with fatal error CS0016: Could not write to output file 'NexusDesktopCompanion.exe' (Access is denied).
rootCauses.rootCause: A previously running instance of NexusDesktopCompanion.exe held an active image file lock on the binary while build.ps1 attempted to overwrite it.
rootCauses.remediation: Hardened build.ps1 to forcefully stop any existing NexusDesktopCompanion.exe instances via Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue before invoking csc.exe. Zero CS0016 errors occur.

rootCauses.symptom: Secondary process invocations returned exit code 0 but emitted no text, causing single-instance test assertions to fail.
rootCauses.rootCause: The mutex acquisition branch in Program.Main previously wrote to an ad-hoc crash.log file and returned silently without outputting the required diagnostic string to standard output.
rootCauses.remediation: Updated Program.Main to print 'NexusDesktopCompanion is already running in background.' to Console.Out when createdNew is false, fulfilling CLI diagnostics and test invariants across Phase 1 and Phase 10.

rootCauses.symptom: Orb suddenly transitioned from IDLE to SPEAKING 600ms after startup; TTS engine was unexpectedly busy during early test phases.
rootCauses.rootCause: An ad-hoc ThreadPool task inside InitializeCompanion() waited 600ms and called ShowOrb('SPEAKING') and _ttsEngine.SpeakAsync('NEXUS is online and listening.'). This interfered with test suites that assumed the companion starts in quiet IDLE standby.
rootCauses.remediation: Removed the unsolicited ThreadPool startup speech task. Speech output is now strictly event-driven (wake phrase, gateway reply, user hotkey, or explicit IPC).

rootCauses.symptom: Phase 7 orb creation test failed asserting 72x72 window dimensions (found 84x84).
rootCauses.rootCause: An experimental border padding adjustment set Form.Size to 84x84 and GraphicsPath region to 80x80.
rootCauses.remediation: Restored canonical 72x72 circular geometry, 72x72 Region clipping, and centered glowing orb shaders.

rootCauses.symptom: Design previously allowed voice command 'unmute' while microphone was muted, creating a physical impossibility.
rootCauses.rootCause: When audio capture is disarmed for privacy, the microphone buffer is zeroed, meaning the STT engine cannot receive acoustic input to hear an 'unmute' phrase.
rootCauses.remediation: Removed 'unmute' from voice grammars. Implemented strict physical unmute via Ctrl+Alt+M toggle, Ctrl+Alt+N press while muted, System Tray context menu, and loopback /audio/mute IPC.
